option_relations.rationale: Ocular Compartment Syndrome is not related to Polyarteritis Nodosa. Polyarteritis Nodosa is a systemic vasculitis, while Ocular Compartment Syndrome refers to increased pressure within the eye.
Orbital Compartment Syndrome is not related to Polyarteritis Nodosa. Polyarteritis Nodosa is a systemic vasculitis, while Orbital Compartment Syndrome refers to increased pressure within the orbit.

Saturday night retinopathy with orbital compression syndrome is not related to Polyarteritis Nodosa. Polyarteritis Nodosa is a systemic vasculitis, while the option describes a specific type of retinopathy and orbital compression.

Orbital compartment syndrome secondary to rhabdomyolysis is not related to Polyarteritis Nodosa. Polyarteritis Nodosa is a systemic vasculitis, while the option describes a specific cause of orbital compartment syndrome.
